line_refinement.units: mask grid samples; source lines use original image xy pixels

split_history: Only shopfront and wing used for tuning. All six other layouts have appeared in earlier reports.

selection.rule: Use development layouts equally. Promote mask-first over B for this surface comparison if mean layout F1 or correctly assigned eligible pixel fraction improves by at least 2 points, the other falls by no more than 2 points, and opening fill increases by at most 1 point. Each line alternative must meet the same rule against mask-first. Among passing methods take highest mean layout F1 then pixel accuracy; prefer mask-first on ties. Ordinary builds also require demonstrated correct metric block placement.

scalelsd.timing: Synchronized model forward only, once per unique image. Model loading, IO and one additional transform self-test excluded.
scalelsd.transform_check: Re-ran first frame with 512x512 output metadata and verified every native x/y coordinate independently.

transform.coordinates: native source pixels, origin at upper-left image edge; model pixel (0,0) center is (+0.5,+0.5) before inverse resize

junctions.algorithm: midpoints of nearby nonparallel segment endpoints

deeplsd.inference_timing: resize + CNN + official PyTLSD extraction/filter + coordinate conversion and junctions; excludes loading, image decode and cache writing
